data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Multi-Agent KV-Cache Capital Deepening, Latent Communication, and Memory Inventory Tokenomics
data.description: Production systems and unit-economics blueprint for cross-context KV-cache reuse across multi-agent grilling rounds (KVComm, Q-KVComm, TokenDance, LRAgent, DroidSpeak), continuous latent inter-agent communication (LatentMAS, Coconut, CODI), and Arrow-Karlin-Scarf memory inventory control theory across single-agent (Reflexion, Generative Agents, Voyager, A-MEM, Mem0, MemGPT, MemoryBank) and multi-agent topologies (SRMT, LEGOMem, Intrinsic Memory Agents, EvoCF, RCR-Router, G-Memory, AgentNet) on G
